title: Workmanship Guarantee Periods and Rework Allowances by Service Level
content:
# Conditions of the Work Order: Workmanship Guarantee Periods and Rework Allowances

The Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service stands behind its own workmanship on your piece for the number of whole months your service level sets, counted from the day the piece is handed back to you. The table gives, for each service level, the guarantee period, whether rework inside the guarantee is carried out without charge, and how many times one order may go back to the bench under the guarantee.

| Service level | Workmanship guarantee, whole months from delivery | Rework inside the guarantee carried out without charge | Times one order may go back to the bench under the guarantee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Bench Service | 6 | yes | 1 |
| Priority Bench Service | 12 | yes | 2 |
| Master Jeweler Service | 18 | yes | 2 |
| Heritage Restoration Service | 24 | yes | 3 |
| Designer Authorized Repair Service | 24 | yes | 3 |
| Atelier White-Glove Service | 36 | yes | 4 |

## Conditions

1. The guarantee period is counted in whole months from the day of delivery: 6 months at Standard Bench Service, 12 at Priority Bench Service, 18 at Master Jeweler Service, 24 at Heritage Restoration Service and at Designer Authorized Repair Service, and 36 at Atelier White-Glove Service.
2. Rework inside the guarantee is carried out without charge at every service level.
3. The rework allowance is the number of times one work order may go back to the bench under the guarantee: once at Standard Bench Service, twice at Priority Bench Service and at Master Jeweler Service, three times at Heritage Restoration Service and at Designer Authorized Repair Service, and four times at Atelier White-Glove Service.

## Hypothetical reading

A hypothetical Priority Bench Service order that has already gone back to the bench twice under the guarantee has used the level's allowance of 2; a hypothetical Atelier White-Glove Service order that has gone back twice still has 2 of its 4 returns in hand.
